title: Dynamic HDR preservation planner
summary: Added a pure Dynamic HDR preservation planner that maps route, policy, DoVi/HDR10+ evidence, tool availability, x265 capability, and encoder posture to preserve/remux/review decisions.
reason: Dynamic HDR detection and tooling existed, but preserve_or_remux/preserve_or_review did not have a deterministic policy helper. This creates a tested decision surface before any high-risk FFmpeg argument or route-selection changes.
behavior_before: Dynamic HDR evidence could warn about expected encode drops and expose tool/capability probes, but there was no reusable pure planner for policy outcomes.
behavior_after: New-DynamicHdrPreservationPlan returns a dynamic_hdr_preservation_plan.v1 object with action, recommended_route, can_preserve_encode, target_dovi_profile, required_artifacts, caveats, and reasons. It is not wired into route selection, FFmpeg arguments, extraction, injection, or file movement.
manual_validation: git diff --check -- <packet touched paths> - passed with LF/CRLF notices only
rollback_plan: Revert New-DynamicHdrPreservationPlan, its tooling-check assertions, the active docs/plan wording, generated summaries, and this packet.
notes:
Add pure Dynamic HDR preserve/remux/review planner without wiring route selection or FFmpeg arguments.
Refresh generated summaries for Dynamic HDR preservation planner changes.
